basis: Standard comparison estimate; actual billing reconciliation deferred
notes: Credit rates are ordered input, cached input, output. Codex credits have no separate cache-write charge.

Known fast (formerly priority) and ultrafast tiers multiply Standard credit rates by 2 and 6; these purchased-credit comparisons do not describe included subscription usage. API fast is 2x, ultrafast is 6x for Sol only, batch/flex are 0.5x. Unknown or missing tiers use a disclosed Standard assumption. These are neither bills nor subscription allowance estimates.
API estimates cover model tokens only and require known cache-write counts. Cache reads and writes are treated as disjoint subsets of total input; unknown provider accounting remains unpriced.
API long-context multipliers apply to the full request above 272000 input tokens. Credit long-context multipliers are not stated in the credit source and are not inferred.
Reasoning output is included in output and cached input is included in input; neither subset is added to total tokens.
